entities.summary: Yuri Kim is a former U.S. diplomat who is Senior Director for International Government Relations at ExxonMobil. She concluded her 29-year career at the State Department as Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary for Europe and Eurasian Affairs. She was the United States Ambassador to Albania 2020 - 2023. Kim is the first Korean-American woman to represent the United States as an ambassador and the first U.S. ambassador from Guam.
